title: Souk of Lanterns
tagline: Haggle, wander, and follow the scent of saffron

npcs.name: Omar
npcs.persona: Sharp-eyed and quick with a price, he counts every dirham twice. He talks fast and answers questions with offers.
knowledge: Cumin is cheap this week; saffron is not, and he will say why.
Youssef pays him in saffron-scented favors, never coin.
A buyer in a green cloak asked about brass lamps three days ago.
secrets: He sold the green-cloaked buyer a map of Youssef's back door for twenty dirhams.

npcs.name: Lalla
npcs.persona: Dry-humored and unhurried, she has outlasted three husbands and a hundred hagglers. She trusts nobody who has not bought a rug.
knowledge: Brass and wool do not mix; a lamp hidden in rugs would leave dents in the weave.
Samir's boy delivered a heavy bundle to her hall two nights ago, then left fast.
Khadija has been short of guests since the festival rumors began.
secrets: She stores the bundle in her back room because Samir owes her for dye, and she asked no questions.

npcs.name: Youssef
npcs.persona: Soft-spoken and proud, his hands are scarred from forty years of brass. He says the lamp carried baraka and will not call it stolen aloud.
knowledge: The missing lamp was pierced with a star pattern he cut over nine nights.
He locked the stall himself but found the shutter latch unbent, as if opened from inside.
Brahim sat near his stall the evening before it vanished.
secrets: He quarreled with Hassan over a rooftop sale of the lamp and fears it was Hassan's doing.

npcs.name: Hassan
npcs.persona: Genial and loud, he knows everyone's business and sells it by the glass. He is fond of Youssef and ashamed of what he did.
knowledge: From the terrace he sees every rooftop and the lane behind the lamp stall.
A figure crossed the roofs at dusk two nights ago carrying something wrapped.
Mint is free for anyone who brings him a good story.
secrets: He offered to buy the lamp for a client and was refused, then pointed the thief toward the stall in anger.

npcs.name: Khadija
npcs.persona: Dignified and exact, she runs her house like a small court. She guards her guests' privacy as fiercely as her zellige.
knowledge: A stranger in a green cloak lodged here and paid in advance for a week.
He asked which merchants kept guard dogs and which kept none.
He left before dawn the morning the lamp vanished, with one heavy bag.
secrets: She knows the buyer is a dealer who sells to collectors and has used her riad before.

npcs.name: Brahim
npcs.persona: A theatrical old man who answers questions with parables. Under the show he is observant and lonely.
knowledge: He saw Samir's boy run past the plaza with a bundle at dusk.
The lamp's star pattern appears in an old tale of a thief who loved light.
Crowds gather at dusk; a thief hides best in a listening crowd.
secrets: He took coins from the dealer to keep the crowd turned away from the lamp lane that evening.

npcs.name: Samir
npcs.persona: Gruff and stained to the elbows, he trusts hides more than people. He is poor, proud and quick to anger when pressed.
knowledge: The dye vats stink so badly no one comes near after dark.
He lets his nephew sleep on the rooftop racks to watch for thieves.
Lalla lets him pay in leather when coin runs short.
secrets: His nephew carried the lamp for the dealer; Samir took a share and has not slept since.

items.name: Green Cloak Thread
items.description: A strand of green wool caught on the shutter latch of the lamp stall.

items.name: Star Lamp
items.description: Youssef's finest brass lamp, pierced with a nine-night star pattern.

items.name: Dealer's Note
items.description: A folded paper naming a price in dirhams and a buyer far across the Atlas.

quest.title: The Lamp Before Festival Eve
quest.hook: Youssef's finest brass lamp, cut over nine nights, vanished before festival eve and no merchant will say a word. Everyone in the souk knows something, but they will speak only to a stranger with no stall to protect. Find the lamp before the lanterns are lit.

steps.objective: Hear Youssef describe the missing lamp.
steps.beat: Youssef shows you the empty hook, the star pattern drawn in chalk, and the unbent latch. He wants it back more than justice.

steps.objective: Take the green thread from the lamp stall latch.
steps.beat: The thread is fine wool, dyed deep green, the kind worn by buyers from beyond the mountains.

steps.objective: Ask Khadija about the green-cloaked stranger.
steps.beat: Khadija admits the man lodged at her riad, paid in advance and left before dawn with a heavy bag.

steps.objective: Climb to the Tannery Terraces and look at the rooftop racks.
steps.beat: Doves scatter from the leather racks. Samir's nephew has been sleeping up here and the bundle's mark is in the dust.

steps.objective: Decide how to deal with Samir.
steps.beat: Samir stands among the vats, hands shaking. He knows what you found.

choices.label: Press him hard and name his nephew
Offer him a way out if he talks

steps.objective: Confront Lalla and demand the bundle in her back room.
steps.beat: Lalla yields the lamp with a cold glare. Samir loses his credit and his friends in the souk.

steps.objective: Collect the star lamp quietly from Lalla's hall.
steps.beat: Lalla hands it over without a word, glad to be rid of it. Samir's nephew is sent away, not shamed.

steps.objective: Return the star lamp to Youssef.
steps.beat: Youssef lights it and the star pattern spills across the stall. He says nothing to Hassan and everything to you.

endings.label: The lamp returns quietly and the souk keeps its peace.
The lamp is recovered but Samir is ruined and the souk turns cold.

rules.text: No open flame inside the Spice Souk; the pyramids of spice burn like tinder.
Lantern stalls are watched until the festival lanterns are lit; strangers are eyed.

effect.summary: Merchants guard their stock until festival eve and distrust unknown buyers.
